item.title: 66 · How I AI · 2026-06-17 · How to design AI agent loops: schedules, goals, and subagents in Claude Code and Codex
item.description:
How I AI · Claire Vo (host, solo build) · aired June 17, 2026 BUILD · HIGH priority · L7 Automations
Why it's here: Defines the four loop types (heartbeat, cron, hook, goal), the five things every loop needs before production (work trees, skills, connectors, subagents, state tracking), then builds two live loops — a self-scheduling 10:15 a.m. reviewer and a weekly loop that spawns subagents to validate its own output.
